outcome: Obstetrical outcome (vaginal delivery, cesarean section, medical termination of pregnancy, lost to follow-up, died undelivered)
New York Heart Association (NYHA) class at admission
cohort: 12 cases of pregnant women presenting with Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (PAH) who reported to a tertiary care center in India over a 24-year period.
finding: Pulmonary arterial hypertension in pregnancy is associated with high maternal mortality (36.36%) and poorer maternal and fetal outcomes, particularly in patients presenting with higher NYHA class and increased PAP, leading to a high incidence of fetal growth retardation.
mod_finding: Among the 10 patients who delivered, 10% had a vaginal delivery, and 50% had a cesarean section.
